name: pkg-folderizer-icon
prompt: Square app icon, 1:1, centered subject with generous padding so it stays readable at small size. Dark charcoal studio background, almost black, color #0B0E14, soft vignette, faint floor reflection. A single 3D mark: a thick matte-charcoal rounded folder, frosted glass, with a bright cyan-blue rim light along the edges. In front of the folder, a smaller sealed package slab (a rounded rectangle, like a game cartridge) is sliding into the folder opening. Where the package meets the folder, one short coral-orange glowing bar, the only warm color. Materials match a premium dark UI: glass, soft cyan glow, one coral accent, no chrome, no metal logos. Photoreal product render, soft key light from the upper left, shallow depth, crisp edges. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO words, NO UI chrome, NO watermark, NO PlayStation symbols, NO Sony marks.
